Reranking with return_documents flag to include document text

```php title="PHP"
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

require_once __DIR__ . '/vendor/autoload.php';

use Liter\Llm\LiterLlm;
use Liter\Llm\RerankRequest;
$req = \Liter\Llm\RerankRequest::from_json(json_encode(["documents" => ["Rust is a systems programming language.", "Iron rusts when exposed to water."], "model" => "rerank-v3.5", "query" => "What is Rust?", "returnDocuments" => true]));
$result = LiterLlm::rerank($req);
var_dump($result->getResults());
var_dump($result->getResults()[0]->getDocument());
var_dump($result->getResults()[0]->relevanceScore);
```
